Starsift is a Python CLI tool designed to detect fake GitHub stars by analyzing account behavior. It leverages GH Archive data and compares a repository's stargazers against a control group of randomly selected accounts from the same time period to identify potential star farms, especially after GitHub restricted access to the stargazers list.

MLX-GRPO is a Python-based training framework for fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs) exclusively on Apple Silicon using Apple's MLX framework. It implements Group-based Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for chain-of-thought prompting and supports universal Hugging Face model conversion, dataset preparation, and inference tools.
